questions.stem: Why is extrapolation (predicting beyond the range of the data) unreliable?

options.text: Because the line of best fit is always curved outside the data range
Because the pattern may not continue outside the range of the data
Because you cannot draw a line beyond the graph
Because there are always outliers beyond the data range

questions.explanation: The relationship observed within the data range may not hold outside it. For example, increasing temperature might increase ice cream sales up to a point, but at extremely high temperatures people may stay indoors.

questions.stem: A line of best fit passes through the point $(20, 35)$ and $(40, 55)$. Use it to estimate the $y$-value when $x = 30$.
